_about: Advice, never a refusal. showrunner's reach gate (lib/showrunner/reach.py) reads this file and adds each rule under the name game_loop:<name>. It reads name, tools, pattern and message, and ignores the rest. A pattern is a Python regex, matched case-insensitively at the START of a command segment, after heredoc bodies are dropped and quoted text is emptied. fires_on and silent_on are this repo's own examples: test/run.py runs every one through the real matcher, so a rule cannot drift from what it claims. Only repos with showrunner installed see these rules.

rules.name: detached-check
rules.message: You are detaching a game_loop check from this session (nohup, setsid or a trailing &). A detached run gives up the completion notification: nothing wakes you when it finishes, and its result sits in a file that only you know to read. Run the same command with the Bash tool's run_in_background instead. It keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits, with its output.
